title: CAIGOS — sealed-surface survey and billing handover for Germany's split sewer charge
money_note: No revenue or deal value is published on the pages read; CAIGOS is a subsidiary of the VIVAVIS group and no funding round exists to record.
summary: Kirkel software house founded 1987 with more than 1,200 municipal and utility customers that, since 2010, has flown and mapped the sealed surfaces of more than 40 municipalities for the gesplittete Abwassergebühr — the German split of the sewer charge into a wastewater part and a rainwater part billed per square metre of roof and paving — and delivers the result to the billing system. Its service runs from aerial survey and cadastre matching through owner questionnaires and a hotline to the fee calculation.
notes: TRACTION: 'Mehr als 1.200 Kunden haben sich bereits für CAIGOS entschieden' (vivavis.com/caigos-gmbh, read 2026-09-04); founded 1987 by Lothar Bubel in Kirkel (business-geomatics.com, 2017-08-15); more than 40 Kommunen on the split charge since 2010, with logos incl. Meissen, Zwickau, Speyer, Ludwigshafen, Lübeck and Regensburg on the service page. CZ ABSENCE CHECK 2026-09-04. Czech queries: 'srážkové vody poplatek výpočet odvodňované plochy software vodárny zákaznický informační systém'; 'evidence zpevněných ploch letecké snímky srážkové vody vodárenská společnost GIS dodavatel odvodňované plochy'; 'pasport zpevněných ploch odvodňované plochy srážkové vody GIS služba obce dodavatel stanovení plochy stočné'; 'výpočet stočného ze srážkových vod z ortofotomapy automaticky software plochy střech vodárenská společnost aplikace'; 'zaměření odvodňovaných ploch pro výpočet srážkových vod nabídka geodetické služby stočné srážkové vody firma'. English query: 'Czech Republic impervious surface mapping stormwater sewer fee software vendor Czechia startup'. Registr smluv full text via Hlídač API: '"srážkových vod" plochy pasport' (1,136 hits, one on subject), 'pasport "zpevněných ploch"' (2,238 hits, none on subject), '"srážkových vod" (ortofoto OR "letecké snímky" OR "odvodňovaných ploch" OR GIS) stočné' (59 hits, none on subject). Surfaces checked: google-cz, ares, cz-contract-parties, own-funded-ledger. FOUND, ADJACENT NOT DIRECT: UTILITIES SYSTEMS / USYS (ARES ICO 17772796, entity 2022, product line since 1992; customers incl. Pražské vodovody a kanalizace, Brněnské vodárny a kanalizace, Ostravské vodárny a kanalizace) and DATAINFO spol. s r.o. (ICO 15046265, 1991; ZIS Vodné a Stočné bills 'vodné, stočné, srážkové vody') invoice the charge from an area keyed in by the operator; Softbit software (27473716, 2005) bills water and sewerage and says nothing about stormwater; Energie AG Kolín a.s., formerly VODOS s.r.o. (47538457, 1993), made a one-off 'pasport ploch podléhajících platbě za odvádění srážkových vod' for Město Kolín on 2019-01-14 for 1,449,918.80 CZK ex VAT (smlouvy.gov.cz/smlouva/8041799) — the city's own sewer operator surveying its own city, not a vendor selling the survey. GIS and orthophoto firms looked up in ARES (T-MAPY 47451084, GEOVAP 15049248, TopGis 29182263, ARCDATA PRAHA 14889749) surfaced on none of the stormwater queries. NO CZECH VENDOR FOUND selling impervious-surface mapping with an owner statement and a billing handover for the stormwater charge. Positive control: the same method (a descriptive Czech query on google-cz) run at a p-0026 incumbent — 'dálkové odečty vodoměrů jako služba pro vodárenské společnosti platforma' — surfaced VODÁRENSKÁ AKCIOVÁ SPOLEČNOST first (vodarenska.cz/vas-nove-nabizi-dalkove-odecty-vodomeru/), then KAPKA vodoměry, ČEVAK and AQUA SERVIS; Softlink did not surface on that query shape. Control PASSED on VAS. Method is producing positives. TRANSFER: the Czech draft amending zákon 274/2001 Sb. (VeKLEP KORNDXBH65S3, RIA authorised 2026-08-27, effective 07/2027) deletes every §20(6) exemption — roads, railways, cemeteries, zoos and households — and the RIA prices the new bill at almost 5bn CZK a year on municipalities and almost 0.5bn on regions; operators today compute the charge from areas customers declare (vodovody-vm.cz, smv.cz).
quote: Bereits seit dem Jahr 2010 haben wir in mehr als 40 Kommunen unterstützend die gesplittete Abwassergebühr mit eingeführt bzw. über eine komplette Neuerfassung der versiegelten Flächen die Überarbeitung der zuvor bereits ein erstes Mal durchgeführten Versiegelungskartierung umgesetzt.

title: Phoenics — sealed-surface cadastre and its updates for Hamburg and Frankfurt's stormwater charge
money_note: No revenue or funding figure is published; a private 11-50 person firm per its LinkedIn page.
summary: Seelze photogrammetry firm founded 1994 that captures and updates sealed-surface cadastres from its own aerial surveys as the basis for the split sewer charge, and has applied its update procedure to Hamburg and Frankfurt as well as smaller towns. title: aquabench — wastewater benchmarking and plant energy check used by more than 800 operators
money_note: No revenue or funding figure is published; a Cologne GmbH founded 2003, no round to record.
summary: Cologne benchmarking company founded 2003 through which more than 800 water and wastewater operators have run comparison projects, including a three-stage energy check for treatment plants modelled on the DWA-A 216 energy-audit standard and the Bavarian state benchmarking it operates. It is the recurring-service shape of the four-yearly plant energy assessment the Czech draft imposes on 200-plus plants.
notes: TRACTION: 'Inzwischen haben mit der aquabench GmbH über 800 Betriebe Projekte durchgeführt' (aquabench.de, read 2026-09-04); 'seit der Gründung 2003' on its news page; it runs Benchmarking Abwasser Bayern and the Schnelltest Energie Kläranlagen (benchmarking.bayern). Search snippets name participants from Belgium, Poland, Switzerland and Austria, but no page read this pass states that sentence, so no markets list is claimed. CZ CHECK 2026-09-04, AND IT IS NOT AN ABSENCE. Czech queries: 'energetický audit ČOV čistírna odpadních vod energetické posouzení dodavatel'; 'optimalizace spotřeby energie ČOV software řízení procesu čistírna digitální dvojče'; 'energetický audit čistírny odpadních vod firma reference energetický specialista vodárenská společnost úspory ČOV studie'; 'VDT Technology digitální dvojče vodárenství ČOV řízení energie'; 'DHI a.s. Praha WEST digitální dvojče ČOV reference Ústřední čistírna odpadních vod modelování energie optimalizace provzdušňování'. Surfaces checked: google-cz, ares, cz-contract-parties, own-funded-ledger. FOUND: the manual equivalent — an energy audit by a licensed energetický specialista under zákon 406/2000 Sb. — is already sold: Veolia's Czech engineers presented it at SOVAK VOD-KA 2025 (Rosenbergová, Veolia: audit every four years, plants above 100,000 PE by 2028, above 10,000 PE by 2032; 'oprávněných auditorů je pouze omezený počet') and the MPO list of specialists is the buyer's reference. Software and modelling: VDT Technology a.s. (ARES ICO 06957021, 2018; En-Key energy management and the Twin Skin digital twin on Siemens Insights Hub; SOVAK associate member; no customer named — EARLY), DHI a.s. title: DESOTEC — mobile activated-carbon filtration as a service, more than 2,000 customers
money_note: Deal value not stated in the 21 November 2025 EQT release (press reports put it near EUR 2bn, not used); Blackstone stays a minority investor.
summary: Roeselare company founded 1990 that rents and swaps mobile activated-carbon filters and reactivates the spent carbon in its own plants, serving more than 2,000 customers across Europe and North America for wastewater, air and PFAS removal; EQT Future agreed to buy a majority stake from Blackstone in November 2025. It is the recurring-service shape of the fourth treatment stage the directive imposes.
notes: TRACTION: 'Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Roeselare, Belgium'; 'operates the world's largest fleet of mobile (re)-activated carbon filters'; 'to more than 2,000 customers across Europe and North America' (eqtgroup.com, 2025-11-21).
